title.ko: 강조·완화 부사: utterly · deeply · fairly · somewhat · barely · hardly
title.en: intensifiers and downtoners: utterly, deeply, fairly, somewhat, barely, hardly

explain.ko: 강조 부사(intensifier)는 형용사나 동사의 정도를 높이고, 완화 부사(downtoner)는 정도를 낮춥니다. 강조: utterly, deeply, thoroughly, immensely, exceedingly, by no means. 완화: fairly, somewhat, rather, slightly, barely, hardly. 어떤 부사는 특정 형용사와만 잘 어울립니다(utterly exhausted, deeply moved, thoroughly enjoy). 같은 뜻이라도 격식과 강도가 다르므로 어울리는 짝을 익히는 것이 중요합니다.
explain.en: Intensifiers raise the degree of an adjective or verb, and downtoners lower it. Intensifiers: utterly, deeply, thoroughly, immensely, exceedingly, by no means. Downtoners: fairly, somewhat, rather, slightly, barely, hardly. Some adverbs pair naturally with specific words (utterly exhausted, deeply moved, thoroughly enjoy). Their strength and formality differ, so learn the typical partners.

notes.ko: 극단적인 형용사(exhausted, brilliant)에는 very보다 utterly, absolutely가 어울립니다.
notes.en: With extreme adjectives (exhausted, brilliant), use utterly or absolutely rather than very.

notes.ko: barely, hardly, scarcely는 이미 부정의 뜻이므로 not과 함께 쓰지 않습니다.
notes.en: Barely, hardly and scarcely are already negative; do not add not.

notes.ko: fairly는 긍정적인 형용사 앞에, rather는 부정적인 형용사 앞에 자주 쓰입니다.
notes.en: Fairly often precedes positive adjectives; rather often precedes negative ones.

prompt.ko: 강조 부사와 완화 부사를 사용해 최근 경험에 대한 감상을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about a recent experience using intensifiers and downtoners.

task.model: I was deeply moved by the film. The plot was somewhat predictable, but the acting was flawless. In the last scene I could barely hold back my tears. It is by no means a lightweight film, so I would recommend it to many people.

model_trans.ko: 저는 그 영화에 깊이 감동했습니다. 줄거리는 다소 예측 가능했지만 연기는 완벽했습니다. 마지막 장면에서는 눈물을 거의 참을 수 없었습니다. 결코 가볍지 않은 영화라서 많은 사람에게 추천하고 싶습니다.
model_trans.en: I was deeply moved by the film. The plot was somewhat predictable, but the acting was flawless. In the last scene I could barely hold back my tears. It is by no means a lightweight film, so I would recommend it to many people.
